notes.title: Cottonville – Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, Cottonville residents! 🌼[/h2][p]
We have come to announce great news. [i]Cottonville [/i]has received a new patch![/p][p]What are the improvements? See the details below! 🌿[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/137e7d39ca7491ee1156a7824c2fc0c100d2f551.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][p]🌸 Mouse support – now you can enjoy the [i]Cottonville [/i]experience also with your mouse and not only a keyboard.[/p][p]🌸 In-game time shown correctly – we have fixed the issue regarding the in-game time being displayed inappropriately.[/p][p]🌸 Animation acceleration – animations and interactions concerning farming, like watering the plants, are now sped up.[/p][p]🌸UI interactions – are now faster, so you can create new outfits even quicker![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/ad569362f77a673a288a34f0883505184fa4de0c.png"][/img][/p][p]We highly appreciate your feedback and support. ❤️🤝 We are constantly monitoring our social media and community channels for your feedback and trying our hardest to make [i]Cottonville [/i]your best cozy gaming experience. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support without which the creation of [i]Cottonville [/i]would not have been possible. 🥰 We continue to do our best to meet all your expectations.[/p]

notes.title: Cottonville - Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes: [h2]Cottonville citizens! 🌿[/h2][p][/p][p]Listening to your requests, we would like to announce to you some [b]important news[/b]! There have been some [b]streamlining changes in [i]Cottonville[/i][/b], and we are happy to bring you the details now! 💖🧵🍀[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/1ffa7209cdfafdafac058885a11ccff0603414f3.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Here are the improvements that have been added to [i]Cottonville[/i]:[/b][/p][p]🌸 Addition of controller support and Steam Deck support with appropriate UI,[/p][p]🌸 Added sprint option with now two speed versions available,[/p][p]🌸 Updated save menu notification (photos before and after).[/p][p][/p][p][b]Before:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/71035ad77e62e0529ec9a3d9c3feae20020df9da.png"][/img][/p][p][b]After:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/1a8ab45439ae7f0dd62b0cebcb7fefb522ae27e9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are constantly monitoring our community and social media channels and take your feedback to heart. We hope to implement more features and continue working on [i]Cottonville[/i]. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/ab420e91a53758d49f6086f0ab35d98a542e2ee4.png"][/img]     [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm, without which the creation of [i]Cottonville[/i] would not have been possible. We will continue to do our best to meet all your expectations. [/p][h3][b]Your enjoyment of the game is our greatest reward [/b]🌱✂️🧶[/h3]

notes.title: Welcome to Cottonville – a place where gardening meets fashion!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Fashionistas!
[/h2][p]Today's finally the day! Your adventure begins in a long-forgotten family business where you’ll craft stunning outfits tailored ✂️🧵 to your neighbors’ unique requests. All of this unfolds in a relaxing, heartwarming atmosphere – the perfect place to unwind and create.[/p][p][b]It's time to bring the atelier back to life! [/b]💖🧶[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/fb7f35cd88244e8d3ccc7164adcd9b0a01197cd0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Cottonville[/i] is a charming blend of RPG and dress-up gameplay[b],[/b] designed with an irresistibly adorable style, heartfelt storytelling, and soft pastel aesthetic.[/p][p]Grow essential crops 🌱 and transform them into cotton, linen, and bamboo, then use vibrant flowers to dye the fabrics 👗! Everything you need to build a thriving designer career is right outside the door – from the softest cotton to the brightest blooms for textile dyeing. 🎨[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478582/b471d53fdfcff4f447f0a9a9ba4915380a999e2e.png"][/img][/p][p]With over 60 sewing designs and 120 variations to create truly unique outfits 🫶. From whimsical festival dresses to elegant everyday wear, the atelier becomes a space where creativity flourishes and new stories are stitched into every seam.
[/p][p]Customize your own look with 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a range of facial and skin tone options to express your personal style. 💅👒[/p][p][/p][p][i]Cottonville[/i] isn’t just a cozy town – it’s a canvas for your imagination. ✨🌈[/p][p]
[/p]
